text: Peaky Blinders is a British period crime drama television series created by Steven Knight, set in Birmingham, England, and following the exploits of the Peaky Blinders crime gang in the direct aftermath of the First World War. The fictional gang is loosely based on a real urban youth gang of the same name active in the city from the 1910s. The series premiered on 12 September 2013 on BBC Two and aired until the fourth series, after which it moved to BBC One for the fifth and sixth series. On 18 January 2021, it was announced that the sixth series would be the final series of Peaky Blinders. Over the course of six series, 36 episodes aired between 12 September 2013 and 3 April 2022. Three months after Tommy recovers from a near-suicide orchestrated by Lizzie and Arthur, a planned massive heist involving the Russians is approaching. Tommy enlists Alfie to appraise the Russians' jewels, which ruins their scheme to provide Tommy with fakes. The Peaky Blinders begin tunneling underneath their mansion. Tommy makes a deal with the Soviet Communists to ensure the guns on the train will be useless, eliminating the need for the train to be blown up—this would sabotage Hughes' plan to plant evidence at the explosion site, incriminating the USSR Communists and leading the United Kingdom to cut off diplomatic relations with Russia. Following the failed suicide attempt by Lizzie and Arthur, Tommy receives a call from the IRA's Captain Swing, who claims credit for preventing Mosley's assassination and returns the bodies of Polly, Aberama, and Barney. The entire Shelby family gathers for Polly's funeral, with Michael swearing revenge on Tommy for her death. In 1933, Tommy, now sober, meets on Miquelon Island with an estranged Michael and business associates of Jack Nelson, a south Boston gang leader and Gina's uncle. After unsuccessful negotiations to re-enter business, Tommy has Michael imprisoned for opium possession. Meanwhile, in Small Heath, Arthur's drug addiction worsens following Polly's death. Later, Tommy is contacted by Lizzie, who informs him that she, Charles, and their daughter Ruby cannot travel to Canada due to Ruby's sudden illness. Believing the illness is a message with gypsy origins, Tommy decides to return to England.
